LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BasicStorage.label: digital storage
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_BasicStorage.description: Unlock the digital storage system. Build a storage core, and items stored inside it take up no map space, never render and never rot.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest1.label: auto-ingest I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest1.description: Unlock auto-ingest. The core absorbs loose items across the map without a hauler.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest2.label: auto-ingest II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest2.description: Raises auto-ingest speed to 5 stacks per 15 ticks.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest3.label: auto-ingest III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_AutoIngest3.description: Raises auto-ingest speed to 10 stacks per 15 ticks.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel2.label: core Lv2
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel2.description: Storage core capacity 500 -> 1000 stacks. Applies immediately to every core already built on the map; no rebuild or reload needed.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel3.label: core Lv3
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel3.description: Storage core capacity 1000 -> 1500 stacks. Applies immediately to every core already built on the map; no rebuild or reload needed.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel4.label: core Lv4
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CoreLevel4.description: Storage core capacity 1500 -> 3000 stacks. Applies immediately to every core already built on the map; no rebuild or reload needed.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy1.label: crafting proxy I
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy1.description: Unlock crafting proxy I: bills on workbenches within 13x13 are completed by the building itself - ingredients are taken from a digital storage core and products go straight back into it.\n\nSkill 5, speed 0.8x, 300W plus the draw of every bench in range.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy2.label: crafting proxy II
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy2.description: Unlock crafting proxy II: skill 10, speed 1.0x, same 300W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy3.label: crafting proxy III
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy3.description: Unlock crafting proxy III: skill 15, speed 1.5x, same 300W.
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy4.label: crafting proxy IV
LanguageData.DigitalStorage_CraftProxy4.description: Unlock crafting proxy IV: skill 20, speed 2.0x, same 300W.\n\nOverclocking (3/6/9 GHz) multiplies speed by 3/6/9 at 9/27/81 times the power draw.
